svg.text: Blue: into the northwest and the Ganga plain. Orange: Multan, then the desert, to Somnath in Gujarat. Both lines start at Ghazni and come back.
Dashed lines are classroom guides, not the exact path of each army. He did not make Delhi his capital.
North India, 1001-1022: Peshawar, Kangra, Thanesar, Mathura, Kannauj, Gwalior, Kalinjar
Gujarat, 1025-26: Ghazni to Multan, across the desert, to Somnath. Return attacked in Sindh, 1027.
Failed push toward Kashmir, 1015. Red is a stop, not a conquest.
He annexed the Punjab frontier and raided beyond it. The deep raids ended back at Ghazni. Coastline: Natural Earth, public domain.
